penetration exceeds 0.15 limit at first violating step 41

counterfactual.change: reduced initial velocity from vx=46.58/vy=35.94 to vx=10/vy=10 to lower speed so discrete substeps can resolve grazing collision without accumulating penetration beyond 0.15

explanation: Shrunk scenario is fast grazing collision with thin horizontal wall (h=0.2). Body approaches at ~58 m/s with vx~46.5. Despite 7 substeps per step, positional correction / discrete collision handling fails to prevent penetration when body grazes top surface of thin wall: at step 39 distance_to_surface = +0.0075 (just outside), step 40 = -0.072 (penetrating 0.072), step 41 = -0.1517 exceeding 0.15 limit. High tangential velocity causes tunneling/grazing penetration accumulating beyond tolerance. Reducing initial speed eliminates violation.
vision_note: The red circle grazes along the top of a thin horizontal grey wall. From step 38 to 41 it visibly sinks deeper into the wall until its bottom half overlaps the wall surface in step 41.
